Package dev.despical.portbridge.tunnel

package dev.despical.portbridge.tunnel
Asynchronous tunnel ownership, lifecycle snapshots and reconnect policy.

One worker serializes process operations and public route checks. Generation tokens discard obsolete callbacks after stop or restart, and immutable snapshots carry connection state to commands and server-thread notifications.
